argument: rdi = the destination object (its first list is the list object at rdi+0x00); rsi = rdi, the destination first list's header (tail position); rdx = the source first list's first node; rcx = the source object's first-list header (range end); called only when the source first list is non-empty; rax not read after the call

rdi = rsi = r12 = the destination object + 0x18, the destination second list taken as its own list object (header at +0x00, size at +0x10 = object + 0x28); rdx = the first surviving source node of the source object's second list, after the caller's lockstep adjustment walk; rcx = the source object + 0x18, the source second list's header (range end); called only when the surviving range is non-empty; rax not read after the call
